partners.question: Are these cars from real rental companies?
partners.answer: Yes. Every listing is a public car from a Benwer partner — a real rental company we work with, not an unverified private advert. If a company or car is not published on the platform, it does not appear here.

booking.question: Do I book and pay on Benwer?
booking.answer: No. You compare partner fleets here, then continue on the rental company’s site to confirm the hire, deposit, and pick-up. Benwer does not take payment on this marketplace.

photos.question: Can I trust the photos and availability?
photos.answer: Listings use the public photos and availability the partner company publishes — the same catalogue they manage in admin. If a car has no public photo yet, we show an empty state rather than a stock picture of a different car. Final availability is confirmed on the company site.

account.question: Do I need an account?
account.answer: No account is required to search. If you send a contact message, we only use those details to reply.

safety.question: Who is responsible for the rental?
safety.answer: The contract is between you and the partner rental company. Read their terms before you confirm. Benwer helps you find a car from a partner fleet; it does not rent vehicles or take payment here.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lede: How we handle personal data when you use the Benwer Cars marketplace.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body:
Benwer Cars (“Benwer”, “we”, “us”) operates a consumer marketplace that helps travellers discover car rental fleets in Málaga province.

This policy covers the marketplace website only. If you continue to a rental company’s own site to book, that company is responsible for the data you submit there.

sections.title: What this marketplace does
sections.body:
You can search cars and companies, compare public fleet details, and continue to a rental company’s site to complete a booking.

Benwer does not take payment or create a rental contract on the marketplace. The rental agreement is between you and the company.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body:
Depending on how you use the marketplace, we may process:

• Search and usage data — location and dates you enter, pages you view, and basic technical data such as IP address, browser, and device information.
• Language preference — stored as a strictly necessary cookie so we can show English or Spanish.
• Cookie consent — stored on your device so we remember your choice.
• Contact messages — name, email, subject, and message if you write to us. We tag these as coming from the marketplace.

We do not ask you to create an account on the marketplace. Booking and payment details are collected by the rental company on their own site, under their own privacy policy.

sections.title: How we use data
sections.body:
We use personal data to operate and improve the marketplace, remember language and cookie choices, respond to contact messages, keep the service secure, and meet legal obligations.

We do not sell your personal data.

sections.title: Legal bases (EEA / UK)
sections.body: Where applicable, we rely on legitimate interests (running a public directory and securing the site), consent (optional cookies, if introduced), legal obligation, and steps needed to reply when you contact us.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.body:
We may use trusted providers for hosting and email delivery. They process data on our instructions.

If you continue to a company site, that company becomes the controller of any data you submit there. We do not pass your contact-form message to rental companies unless you ask us to.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: We use a strictly necessary language cookie and store your cookie choice on your device. See the cookie policy for details. Optional cookies stay off unless you accept them.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep contact messages as long as needed to reply and for a reasonable follow-up period. Technical logs are kept for a short period. Your cookie choice stays until you change it or clear site data.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body:
Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, rectify, erase, restrict, or port your data, and to object to certain processing. You may also lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.

To exercise your rights, use the contact page.

sections.title: International transfers
sections.body: If data is transferred outside your country, we use appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses or equivalent mechanisms where required by law.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will post the revised version on this page and update the “Last updated” date.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lede: The rules for using the Benwer Cars marketplace to discover rental fleets.

sections.title: The marketplace
sections.body:
Benwer Cars provides a public directory of car rental companies and their published fleets. You can compare cars and continue to a company’s own website to finish a rental.

These terms apply to the marketplace website. They do not replace the rental company’s own terms, which apply when you book with them.

sections.title: Bookings are with rental companies
sections.body:
Benwer does not rent cars, take payment, or enter into a hire contract on the marketplace.

If you continue to a company site, any booking, deposit, insurance, and pick-up arrangement is between you and that company. Read their terms before you confirm.

sections.title: Listings and availability
sections.body:
Fleet details, prices, photos, and availability are published by rental companies and may change. We aim to show public information accurately, but we do not guarantee that a car will still be available or that a listed price will be honoured until the company confirms it.

Dates you enter on the marketplace help you search. Final availability is confirmed on the company site.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Use the marketplace lawfully. Do not scrape, overload, or interfere with the service, submit false contact details, or use the site to harm other people or businesses.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body:
The marketplace is provided as a discovery service. To the extent permitted by law, Benwer is not liable for rental disputes, vehicle condition, or bookings completed on a company’s site.

Nothing in these terms limits rights you have as a consumer that cannot be waived under applicable law.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms. The “Last updated” date on this page shows the current version. Continued use after a change means you accept the updated terms.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms or the marketplace can be sent from the contact page. For a booking you already started, contact the rental company directly.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.lede: How we use cookies and similar technologies on the marketplace.

sections.title: What we use
sections.body:
Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We also use similar storage, such as local storage, to remember choices.

This policy covers the Benwer Cars marketplace. When you continue to a rental company’s site, that site may set its own cookies.

sections.title: Strictly necessary
sections.body:
We use a language cookie so the site can show English or Spanish. This is required for the marketplace to work as you expect.

Your cookie-banner choice is stored on your device so we do not ask again on every visit. That storage is not used to advertise to you.

sections.title: Optional cookies
sections.body:
Optional cookies (for example analytics) stay off unless you choose Accept all.

Today the marketplace does not set analytics or marketing cookies. If we add them later, we will describe them here and they will still require your acceptance.

sections.title: Managing cookies
sections.body: Use the banner to accept all cookies or keep only what is necessary. You can also delete cookies and site data in your browser. Blocking the language cookie may reset English or Spanish on your next visit.

sections.title: More information
sections.body: See the privacy policy for how we handle personal data, or send a message from the contact page.
